source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 7 aprilie — «Sfânta Muceniță Achilina»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 7ης Απριλίου — «Αγία Ακυλίνα»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 7 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and prints no years for her: the only date anywhere on it is the reign of «τοῦ παρανόμου Δεκίου (249 - 251)» inside the notice it quotes from Laura Codex 170, and no `dates` were taken from a reign. The page prints no hymn for her. Unlike doxologia, saint.gr joins her to Rufinus the deacon and to two hundred martyrs, all three on 7 April and all three carrying the same notice; it says nothing of a mother of Calliopius.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).
